notes.title: Content Update - Indian museums in Kubits Gallery!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Mu_M7Xc8c7k;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi,

Thank you for playing and enjoying Kubits Gallery, here is the first free content update for the game today:

- Two new museums with beautiful paintings from India! First museum is the colored Holi Festival and then of course the Yogallery
- 30 new levels to play
- A few french translation mistakes corrected

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871479/97b818cbfa301873b95e51e3a78abb0af7f81044.png[/img]

Have fun!

Edwin, NoLAN Games.

notes.title: Small patch 1.06
notes.notes: Hi just a small patch to add a setting for VSync (enabled by default).

notes.title: Kubits Gallery is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Artists of anywhere, the is a serious announcement : all paintings in the world mysteriously vanished!
You have to help the Kubits to restore every painting in the museum by solving nonograms!

The full Kubits Gallery game is out now, you can get it right now on Windows and macOS with a discount of -10% for 10 days only.

[previewyoutube=M_lBL8Zhx8U;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you will enjoy playing the game as much as I enjoyed making it

Edwin, NoLAN Games.

notes.title: Demo day-one patch
notes.notes:
Hi,

A little day-one patch for the demo, here are the changes:

- Cross removes square setting now always removes square
- New setting for Square removes Cross added
- Fixed a music bug when restarting an already won picross
- Win sound (fireworks) is less loud now
- Done numbers are more transparent
[strike]- Hidden picross?[/strike]

Thank you to everyone who played and enjoyed the demo, and to everyone who gave me your feedbacks it's always appreciated.

Have fun,
Edwin.

notes.title: Next Fest demo is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm glad to announce that the demo for Kubits Gallery is out now for the Steam Next Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871479/3cd09cd5bbd7a9bdafb7cff7136061e20a6cd513.jpg[/img]

I hope you will enjoy this first preview for the full game, 12 levels are available here, the full game will be available soon with over 120 levels at launch and more to come.

If you liked it please add the full game to you wishlist:
